page_note: Page contains the tail of one chapter (hortatory image of pearl/vessel), then chapter 104 — a substantive cosmological-anthropological teaching mapping food → five offspring within the body of man (breath, voice, power-and-shame, sexual offspring through pleasure, bodily offspring molded in flesh). This five-fold structure with ordinal enumeration is classic substrate teaching, mapping cosmos→cosmos within the body. Chapter 105 begins at the page bottom with 'Christian men sown in the world' which signals an ecclesial/hortatory frame rather than substrate. One clear dialogue frame at seg 6 ('again he said to his disciples') and another at seg 28 ('Once again he said' — flagged as seam). Substrate dominates the body of the page.

segments.temporal_note: Tail of preceding chapter — 'they shall be established/perfected within him' — pastoral exhortation.
'shall become an unfailing vessel and a pearl' — pearl/vessel imagery applied to the disciple, classic hortatory metaphor.
Closing of pearl exhortation.
